name: Should I choose a hardwired or plug-in heated towel rack for my bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a hardwired or plug-in heated towel rack for my bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a hardwired and plug-in heated towel rack depends on your preference for aesthetics and installation flexibility. Hardwired units offer a cleaner, more integrated look, as wiring is concealed within the wall, aligning with the seamless design of a luxury bathroom. They typically require professional installation during a renovation. Plug-in models offer easier installation and portability, but the visible cord may detract from a high-end aesthetic. As part of our design-build process, we can discuss which option best suits your vision for a spa-inspired retreat.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hardwired racks offer a clean, integrated look for luxury bathrooms, requiring professional installation. Plug-in models are simpler but have visible cords. Your choice depends on aesthetics and installation flexibility.
